info.title: MagicWP API
info.description:
The MagicWP public API. Authenticate with an API token created in the dashboard (Settings → API tokens): `Authorization: Bearer mwp_…`. A token works in one workspace and can do what both its own permissions and your current role there allow; each operation names the permission it needs (`x-required-permission`). Every response is wrapped in the same envelope. Limits: 300 reads and 60 writes per minute per token; 20 failed authentications per IP per 10 minutes.

**Errors** carry a stable `code` (see the ErrorCode schema) next to a human `message`.

**Lists** of things you own are paged: `?limit=` (1-100, default 50) and `?cursor=`, answered as `{items, next_cursor}`; pass `next_cursor` back until it is null.

**Long actions** return `{task}` (several sites: `{tasks}`); poll `GET /v1/tasks/{task_id}` until `status` is `completed` or `failed`.

**Retries**: heavy writes accept an `Idempotency-Key` header.

**Who am I**: `GET /v1/tokens/current`. Guide: https://docs.magicwp.io/account/api-tokens

parameters.name: include_staging

schema.description: Include staging copies. Off by default because this feeds the site switcher, the clone-into picker and anything that counts sites — a staging copy in any of those is the one that eventually gets cloned over by accident. Callers that opt in get them mixed into the same list and must tell them apart by `parent_site_id`.

DemoCreate.title: DemoCreate
DemoCreate.description:
Body for POST /sites/demo.

Deliberately smaller than SiteCreate. There is no `storage_limit` (the demo
plan decides, and a caller-supplied number on a free site is a hole rather
than a feature), no `site_type` (a demo exists to show WordPress, so it is
always a full site) and no `wp_admin_email` (it is the account's).

`region` is here because the ordinary create form offers it and a demo
should land near its owner like any other site. It is passed to
select_server exactly as SiteCreate's is.

data.description: The result; on an error, details such as `code` and `permission`.

ErrorCode.description: Stable error code. New codes may be added; existing ones do not change meaning. `admin_2fa_enrollment_required`: Staff two-factor enrollment is required (admin only). `bad_request`: The request cannot be carried out as sent (400). `conflict`: The item's current state does not allow this (409). `disposable_email`: Sign-up with a temporary or blocked email domain is not allowed. `dns_records_exist`: The domain already has DNS records that would be replaced. `forbidden`: Not allowed (403). `gone`: The item is no longer available (410). `idempotency_in_progress`: A request with this Idempotency-Key is still running. `idempotency_key_reused`: This Idempotency-Key was used with a different request. `internal_error`: Something failed on our side (500). `ip_not_allowed`: The token is not allowed from this address. `limit_reached`: A plan or per-site limit has been reached. `mcp_not_allowed`: The workspace's plan does not include MCP access (`data.reason` says why). `method_not_allowed`: This method is not supported on this path (405). `not_found`: The item does not exist, or is not in this workspace (404). `oauth_consent_mismatch`: The MCP connection consent screen is stale or was opened by someone else; reload it. `owner_2fa_required`: The workspace Owner must turn on two-factor authentication first. `owner_only`: Only the workspace Owner can do this. `payload_too_large`: The request body is too large (413). `permission_denied`: The token or your role lacks `data.permission`. `rate_limited`: Too many requests; see Retry-After (429). `site_busy`: Another action is running on this site; retry when it finishes. `site_not_ready`: The site is not in a state that allows this yet. `token_wrong_workspace`: The token belongs to a different workspace than the one named. `unauthenticated`: Missing, invalid, expired or revoked credentials (401). `upstream_error`: The hosting server or a provider did not complete the action (502/503/504). `validation_error`: The request failed validation; `data` lists the fields (422). `workspace_2fa_required`: Two-factor authentication is required to work in this workspace. `workspace_locked`: The workspace is locked. `workspace_required`: A signed-in request did not name its workspace (X-Workspace-Id).
